$comment: Per-node patches. {node, css, reason} appends CSS to the generated declarations; {node, asset, reason} draws an IMAGE-SVG root with another exported asset. Reason is mandatory. Keep it under 30; fix the general rule in scripts/gen/lib/*.mjs first.

overrides.reason: SEND Home 'Receiving market' icon is named chevron-down in Figma but its vector is an arrow (10.5x10.5 at 3.75..14.25, same as arrow-right; see 2-4235_home.png). Assets are exported once per name, so chevron-down.svg holds the real chevron.
